decision_rule: PASS iff fresh private instrumented index enumerates each scoped skip and large exclusion, all scope skips are proved empty, no unreadable inputs or unexpected diagnostics, both native upstream impacts are complete and non-HIGH/non-CRITICAL, source/tool snapshot custody holds and scan_complete is emitted. HIGH/CRITICAL stops for owner review; stop on drift, unknown skip/schema, STOP or deadline. Does not identify R2 skip or adjudicate historical controls.
notes: New explicitly instrumented private tool/source snapshot; preserves full gate and does not reconstruct R2 skip.
